SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATING.title: Spectating
SPECTATEMOD-WHAT_GETS_REPLACED.title: What gets replaced
SPECTATEMOD-INDICATORS.title: Indicators
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_AFTER_END_TURN: Auto spectate after ending your turn
Automatically switch to a teammate who is still alive and has not ended their turn.
SPECTATEMOD-MANUAL_SPECTATE_ON_CLICK.des: Click a teammate to start or stop spectating them. Click your own character to stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-PREFERRED_TEAMMATE_SLOT.desc: Teammate to prefer for auto spectate. 0 picks the first eligible teammate. If the preferred teammate is dead or has ended their turn, another eligible teammate is used.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.title: Replace your hand
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.description: Show the spectated teammate's hand in place of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.title: Replace combat UI
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.descriptio: Point the draw, discard and exhaust piles, the energy orb and the star counter at the teammate you are watching.
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.title: Mirror card hover
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.description: Raise the card the teammate is inspecting.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.title: Show card play and targeting
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.descr: Draw the teammate's targeting line and selection reticle in your own view.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.title: Show "Spectating" label
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.descri: Show the name of the player you are watching at the top of the screen.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.title: Show red screen border
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.descr: Outline the screen in red while spectating.
